purpose: Canonical self-scoped Event expectation descriptor. B14-U2 extends the original B03 title/creation descriptor with optional description, location and per-item color override while preserving Event identity and keeping temporal placement in Schedule.

columns.name: event_ref
columns.meaning: Stable Event NativeRef whose expectation descriptor this row carries.
columns.value_contract: References one existing UUIDv7 Event identity; this row does not mint or replace that identity.

columns.name: self_person_ref
columns.meaning: Authenticated DANTE self Person whose personal Event context owns this descriptor.
columns.value_contract: Existing Person NativeRef resolved through DanteContext; Person remains distinct from Account, Principal and Actor.

columns.name: title
columns.meaning: User-authored expected-occurrence title for the Event.
columns.value_contract: Trimmed, non-empty, at most 300 characters; Schedule placement, recurrence, participation and outcome do not belong in this column.

columns.name: description
columns.meaning: Optional canonical descriptive text captured with Event authoring.
columns.value_contract: NULL or trimmed non-empty text; description is not Schedule, Agenda, Participation or Outcome state.

columns.name: location
columns.meaning: Optional canonical Event location supplied by the author.
columns.value_contract: NULL or trimmed non-empty text; location is descriptive Event metadata and does not become temporal placement.

columns.name: color_code
columns.meaning: Optional per-Event presentation color override independent of Life Area color.
columns.value_contract: NULL or uppercase #RRGGBB. It does not create or imply a Life Area assignment.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: Canonical creation instant recorded by the bounded CreateEvent capability.
columns.value_contract: Statement-time instant supplied inside the authoritative PostgreSQL create capability.

primary_key.name: pk_event_expectation
primary_key.reason: Exactly one current Event expectation descriptor is materialized per Event identity.

foreign_keys.name: fk_event_expectation_event_ref_event
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: The descriptor belongs to the existing Event native owner rather than creating a second Event root.

foreign_keys.name: fk_event_expectation_self_person_ref_person
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: The Event descriptor is self-scoped while preserving Event as distinct from Participation/Actor semantics.

check_constraints.name: ck_event_expectation_title
check_constraints.reason: Reject empty, padded or unbounded Event titles at the database boundary.

check_constraints.name: ck_event_expectation_description
check_constraints.expression_contract: description IS NULL OR (description=btrim(description) AND description<>'')
check_constraints.reason: Optional Event description must be canonical trimmed non-empty text when present.

check_constraints.name: ck_event_expectation_location
check_constraints.expression_contract: location IS NULL OR (location=btrim(location) AND location<>'')
check_constraints.reason: Optional Event location must be canonical trimmed non-empty text when present.

check_constraints.name: ck_event_expectation_color_code
check_constraints.reason: Optional per-item color is stored only as canonical uppercase #RRGGBB.

indexes.name: ix_event_expectation_self_person_created
indexes.reason: Deterministic self-scoped Event ordering without making presentation order canonical truth.

state_history.current_binding: The Event descriptor is selected directly by Event NativeRef; Schedule current/history remains a separate shared capability.
state_history.chronology: created_at records the authoritative Event creation instant; UUIDv7 ordering is never used as chronology.
state_history.immutability_policy: Runtime has no generic descriptor UPDATE authority. B14-U2 authoring may initialize description, location and color atomically during creation through a bounded SECURITY DEFINER capability; later editing requires its own governed mutation design.

lifecycle.retention: Retained with the canonical Event even when the Event has no current Schedule, including postponed/TBD lifecycle states.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE. Destructive evolution requires a separately reviewed forward migration.

obligations: Event identity remains the existing UUIDv7 NativeRef and is not duplicated by the descriptor
runtime can read but cannot directly INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE the descriptor
title, optional description/location and color integrity are enforced in PostgreSQL
Life Area assignment is optional and absence of an assignment row is valid
Event descriptor contains no Schedule, Recurrence, Participation, Session, Actual or Outcome collapse
